prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a reusable CLOSE / DISMISS icon for the general UI of Vandrheim RPG.
Create ONE standalone close icon, a bold perfectly balanced symmetrical diagonal X. The two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, showing the exact warm brass fill, restrained light edge bevel and dark charcoal outline from the existing UI family. Match their visual treatment closely.
Subject: two short broad diagonal brass strokes crossing into one solid clear X silhouette. Equal-length arms, equal stroke width, clean slightly chamfered ends, sharp readable negative gaps. Warm muted brass #C89445 as main color, one restrained cream-gold edge highlight and a slightly darker ochre flat face, thick dark charcoal #292A2E perimeter. Very shallow illustrated bevel like the curved arrows of reference 1. This is a simple close symbol for every UI panel, immediately legible at 16–32 pixels.
Flat clean illustrated game UI art with minimal shading. Center the complete X at about 76–80% of a square canvas, with generous even transparent margins. Genuinely transparent background, clean alpha, no black background. No circle, surrounding badge, square backing, button frame, extra border, skull, arrows, runes, crossed swords, central bolt, decorative knot, lettering, labels, numbers, glow, particles, drop shadow, gritty texture or photoreal 3D metal. Only the X; match the style of the references while keeping it a universal close symbol.
